newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shareholders okay Fairwood rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Shareholders okay Fairwood rights plan.

text.p: Fast food chain operator Fairwood Holdings Ltd said on Monday its shareholders had approved the company's rights issue proposal on the basis of one rigths shares for every two existing shares.

Fairwood has also obtained shareholders' approval at a general meeting to double the authorised share capital of the company to HK$120 million by creation of an additional 600 million new shares, it said.
Earlier this month, the company had proposed to raise HK$83 million by way of a rights issue of 237.24 million new shares at HK$0.35 each.

It said proceeds would be used to fund capital investments in opening six new shops in Hong Kong and China in the current financial year, and to repay banks borrowings, reducing its gearing level and interest expenses.
Fairwood shares rose HK$0.015 to HK$0.455 at midday.
